Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend.
I'm sure you understand why I am here.
He was my prey, and you interfered.
How interesting. Two chefs who both coincidentally use foul ingredients to make appetizing goods. Uniting together to save others.
A heartwarming tale…if not for the fact that you could have saved another instead. But don't worry, I won't spoil the story. It's not my role.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live and breathe in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*.
You, my friend, are my final subject. Your choices, your bonds, they were all very beneficial to my study.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. There's not much left. I hope you enjoy the ride of what's left.
